# RecDiffy.NET

> RecDiffy.NET is an MIT-licensed reconciliation engine for .NET 8 and later. Give it two lists of records, called left and right, and a profile that declares the fields, how each side's cells are normalized, optional lifecycle and package consolidation, the matching passes and the comparison tolerances. It matches the records, compares every field at the tolerance you set, and explains every row left over. A reconciliation runs Normalize → Consolidate → Match → Compare → Explain. Every NuGet release is a prerelease, so install with `dotnet add package RecDiffy --prerelease`.

Notes for language models:

- Read the agents page first. It says which API fits which job, and the rules that keep a result correct.
- Use only types and members that the public API baseline lists. When a doc and the code disagree, the code is right.
- Matched doesn't mean balanced, and missing isn't zero: read each matched entry's outcome, and check for null before reading a delta.
- The repository's root AGENTS.md is for agents that change RecDiffy.NET itself, not for agents that use it.
- Everything below, joined into one file: https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/llms-full.txt

## Start here

- [RecDiffy.NET for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/docs/agents.md): which API to pick, install, the engine, profiles in code, FIX, and the rules for a correct result
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/README.md): ten typed examples with RecBuilder, a CSV quickstart with a JSON profile, consolidation, cultures, Excel reports and troubleshooting

## The engine

- [Profile reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/PROFILES.md): every profile section and key, every core and trading rule, routes, passes, tolerances, attributions, limits, compile errors and run diagnostics
- [Profile examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/PROFILE-EXAMPLES.md): profiles that run, with the output each gives
- [What a result means](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/RESULTS.md): alignment, composition, outcome and disposition; ambiguity, incomplete search, quarantine, suppression, provenance (Raw, Canonical, Trace) and counting
- [Result examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/RESULT-EXAMPLES.md): real engine output for each result concept
- [Support matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/SUPPORT.md): what each package supports, and how each claim is checked
- [Capacity and concurrency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/CAPACITY.md): how large a reconciliation can be, and how many can run at once
- [Excel report layouts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/report-specs/README.md): what each RecDiffy.Excel report shows

## Profiles in code

- [Typed reconciliation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/docs/typed-reconciliation/README.md): RecBuilder with your own objects and typed lambdas, step by step
- [BuiltProfile.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Samples/BuiltProfile.cs): a profile built with ProfileBuilder, SideBuilder and PathBuilder, its problems by location, and a header check
- [TypedReconciliation.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Samples/TypedReconciliation.cs): a runnable RecBuilder sample
- [FirstReconciliation.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Samples/FirstReconciliation.cs): a JSON profile run over objects with RecordSources.FromObjects and SourceMap
- [TradingReference.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Samples/TradingReference.cs): the trading rule pack with reference data
- [ResultReading.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Samples/ResultReading.cs): reading a result, with a quarantined row

## FIX messages

- [Reconciling FIX messages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/docs/FIX-RECIPE.md): which FIX messages become rows, the columns of each file, and the rules a FIX reconciliation depends on
- [FixRows.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix/FixRows.cs): the flattener: orders, fills, allocations and trade reports as rows, plus what was skipped or rejected
- [FixReader.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix/FixReader.cs): the strict tag=value reader and every check it makes
- [FixMessage.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Fix/FixMessage.cs): FixOptions, FixMessage, FixAccepted, FixRejected and FixSkipped
- [orders.profile.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/test-data/fix-reconciliation/orders.profile.json): the sample profile for flattened orders; fills, allocations, trades and executions profiles sit beside it

## API reference

- [RecDiffy public API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Tests/ApiBaseline/RecDiffy.txt): every public type and member of the RecDiffy package, one per line
- [RecDiffy.RulePacks.Trading public API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy.Tests/ApiBaseline/RecDiffy.RulePacks.Trading.txt): the trading rule pack's public types and members
- [IReconciliationResult.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy/Results/IReconciliationResult.cs): the result interface
- [ResultModel.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy/Results/ResultModel.cs): entries, rows, diffs, explanations and the run summary
- [RecPush.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy/Push/RecPush.cs): Push and Snapshot, the extensions that reconcile rows pushed in batches
- [RuleRegistry.cs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/m-vaysman/recdiffy.net/main/RecDiffy.NET/src/RecDiffy/RuleRegistry.cs): the core rule names and the classes they build
